name: Feature work
description: One piece of work on one repository, done by an agent and looked at by you before it is finished. Two agent terminals (one builds, one reviews), a plain shell, a workflow with a stop for your approval, and a rule that notifies you when a task needs you.

terminal.name: builder
terminal.note: Does the work of a task, on the workflow “Build, then your look”.

terminal.name: reviewer
terminal.note: Reads what the builder changed and hands in a list of what it found.

terminal.name: shell
terminal.note: Yours: run the tests, look at the difference.

workflow.name: Build, then your look
workflow.description: Plan, build, check, and stop for the owner before finishing.

elements.name: Plan
elements.instructions:
Read the task: {{task}}
Read the code it touches. Write down, in a few lines, what you will change and how you will know it works. Change nothing yet.
elements.doneWhen: The plan is in your note, and nothing was changed.

elements.name: Build
elements.instructions: Make the change you planned. Keep it to the task. Add or change tests so that they would fail without it.
elements.doneWhen: The change is made and the tests that cover it pass.

elements.name: Check
elements.instructions: Run the project's own checks. Read your whole difference once as if someone else wrote it. Fix what you find.
elements.doneWhen: The checks pass, and your note says what was changed and what was left out.

elements.name: Your look
elements.ask: Read the difference and the note. Approve to finish, or send it back with what to change.
elements.lookAt: The difference of the terminal's working copy, and its note.

elements.name: Finish
elements.instructions: Commit the change on its branch with a message that says what it does and why. Do not push and do not merge.
elements.doneWhen: The change is committed on its own branch.

element.name: Review the change
element.instructions:
Read the difference of this repository against its main branch: {{task}}
Look for what is wrong, what is missing a test, and what is not needed. Do not change anything.
element.doneWhen: A list is handed in: one line for each thing found, most important first. An empty list if nothing was found.
